articles.title: U.S., Partner Nations to Hold Annual Malabar Naval Exercise Near Japan
articles.description: The United States, Australia, India and Japan will carry out this year’s iteration of the annual Malabar naval exercise in the waters near Japan next week. Malabar 2026 will take place south of the Kanto region on the main island of Honshu from Nov. 5-12, according to a Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force news release published on Tuesday. “The JMSDF will conduct a multilateral exercise ‘MALABAR 2026’ with the U.S. Navy , the Indian Navy, the Royal Australian Navy and the Royal Australian Air Force as described below in order to realize a ‘Free and Open Indo-Pacific’,” reads the release.
